modifiers.AddAttributes.defs.AttributeSpec.name.de: Name of the created attribute; if it already exists, its value is replaced.
modifiers.AddAttributes.defs.AttributeSpec.type.de: auto: the type of the expression. Otherwise the result is converted (failure: see "On failure").
modifiers.AddAttributes.description: Adds or replaces attributes computed by SQL expressions.
modifiers.AddAttributes.help: Each attribute is computed by a DuckDB SQL expression, in order: an expression can use the attributes created above. Examples: "surface" * 2 ; upper("nom") ; CASE WHEN "pop" > 1000 THEN 'ville' ELSE 'village' END ; ST_Area(geometry). A feature whose expression fails (or whose value cannot be converted to the requested type) goes to "Rejected" with the reason; with "On failure: null", the attribute stays empty.
modifiers.AddAttributes.label: Create attributes
modifiers.AddAttributes.params.attributes.descript: Computed in order: each one can use the previous ones.
modifiers.AddAttributes.params.attributes.title: Attributes to create
modifiers.Aggregate.description: Groups features by key: one feature per group, with the feature count and sums.
modifiers.Aggregate.help: The attributes of the aggregated feature are those of the first feature of the group. Geometry: "collect" gathers the geometries without merging them (MultiPolygon, MultiPoint… or a mixed collection), "first" keeps the first feature's, "none" removes it. To really merge polygons, use the Dissolve.
modifiers.Aggregate.label: Aggregate
modifiers.Aggregate.params.count_attribute.title: Feature count attribute
modifiers.Aggregate.params.geometry.description: collect: gathers the group's geometries without merging them; first: the first feature's; none: no geometry.
modifiers.Aggregate.params.geometry.title: Geometry
modifiers.Aggregate.params.group_by.description: Empty = everything in a single group.
modifiers.Aggregate.params.group_by.title: Group by
modifiers.Aggregate.params.sum_attributes.title: Attributes to sum
modifiers.Buffer.description: Replaces each geometry with a buffer of the given distance.
modifiers.Buffer.help: The distance is in the unit of the coordinate system (meters in Lambert-93); refused for a geographic system (degrees). It can come from an attribute. A negative distance shrinks a polygon (empty result = feature to "Rejected"). Features without geometry or with an invalid distance go to "Rejected".
modifiers.Buffer.label: Buffer
modifiers.Buffer.params.distance.description: In the unit of the coordinate system (meters in Lambert-93). Negative: shrinks a polygon.
modifiers.Buffer.params.distance_attribute.title: Distance from an attribute
modifiers.Buffer.params.end_cap.description: Shape of line ends: round, flat, square.
modifiers.Buffer.params.end_cap.title: Line ends
modifiers.Buffer.params.join.description: Shape of corners: round, mitre (sharp), bevel (cut).
modifiers.Buffer.params.join.title: Corners
modifiers.Buffer.params.quad_segs.description: Smoothness of curves: segments per quarter circle.
modifiers.Buffer.params.quad_segs.title: Segments per quarter circle
modifiers.BuildList.description: Gathers the values of an attribute into a list: one feature per group, with the list of values.
modifiers.BuildList.help: Features are grouped by "Group by" (empty = a single group); the list gathers the values of "Values attribute", in arrival order (or sorted, or without duplicates). Empty values are ignored. Geometry: "none" (no geometry) or "first" (that of the first feature of the group). The list is a list-typed attribute: "Explode a list" does the opposite.
modifiers.BuildList.label: Build a list
modifiers.BuildList.params.attribute.description: The values that go into the list.
modifiers.BuildList.params.attribute.title: Values attribute
modifiers.BuildList.params.distinct.title: Without duplicates
modifiers.BuildList.params.geometry.description: none: no geometry; first: that of the first feature of the group.
modifiers.BuildList.params.geometry.title: Geometry
modifiers.BuildList.params.group_by.description: Empty = a single group for all features.
modifiers.BuildList.params.group_by.title: Group by
modifiers.BuildList.params.list_name.title: List attribute
modifiers.BuildList.params.sort.description: Sorted values; otherwise in arrival order.
modifiers.BuildList.params.sort.title: Sort
modifiers.CastAttributes.defs.Conversion.decimal_c: Reads "12,5" as 12.5 (text to number): removes spaces and replaces the comma.
modifiers.CastAttributes.defs.Conversion.type.desc: text, integer, float, boolean, date or datetime.
modifiers.CastAttributes.description: Changes the type of several attributes at once: text, integer, decimal, boolean, date.
modifiers.CastAttributes.help: Each row converts an attribute in place. A value that cannot be converted ("abc" to integer) sends the feature to "Rejected" with the reason, unless "Unconvertible value" is null: it then becomes empty. "Decimal comma" reads numbers the French way ("1 234,5"). Recognized booleans: true/false, oui/non, 1/0. An empty value stays empty.
modifiers.CastAttributes.label: Convert attribute types
modifiers.CastAttributes.params.on_error.descripti: reject: the feature goes to "Rejected"; null: the value becomes empty.
modifiers.CastAttributes.params.on_error.title: Unconvertible value
modifiers.Centroids.description: Replaces each geometry with a point: centroid, interior point or bounding-box center.
modifiers.Centroids.help: "centroid": center of gravity (can fall outside a crescent-shaped polygon); "point_on_surface": a point always inside; "bbox_center": center of the bounding box. Features without geometry or with an empty geometry go to "Rejected".
modifiers.Centroids.label: Replace with a center point
modifiers.Centroids.params.method.description: centroid: center of gravity (can fall outside a crescent polygon); point_on_surface: a point always inside; bbox_center: center of the bounding box.
modifiers.Centroids.params.method.title: Method
modifiers.CheckValidity.description: Splits valid geometries from invalid ones (self-intersection, unclosed ring…).
modifiers.CheckValidity.help: Valid features leave on "Valid", the others on "Invalid" with the reason in `_invalid_reason`. Empty or missing geometry: "Invalid" (unless unchecked). To fix invalid geometries, use "Repair geometries".
modifiers.CheckValidity.label: Validate geometries
modifiers.CheckValidity.params.reject_empty.descri: Checked: an empty or missing geometry goes to "Invalid"; unchecked: it goes to "Valid".
modifiers.CheckValidity.params.reject_empty.title: Reject empty or missing geometries
modifiers.Clip.description: Clips the "input" features by the "overlay" polygons: inside and outside parts.
modifiers.Clip.help: "union": the overlay polygons are merged; each feature gives at most one "Inside" part (within the overlay) and one "Outside" part. "each": one "Inside" part per overlay polygon covering it, with the chosen overlay attributes (prefixed): it is an intersection with attributes. Empty parts are dropped, and so are mere contacts (a parcel touching the overlay along an edge stays whole outside). A feature entirely inside or outside goes out unchanged, without computation: only the features straddling the boundary are clipped. Features without geometry, or that the clipping could not process, go to "Rejected".
modifiers.Clip.label: Clip
modifiers.Clip.params.mode.description: union: the overlay polygons are merged (at most one Inside part per feature); each: one Inside part per overlay polygon covering the feature.
modifiers.Clip.params.mode.title: Overlay polygons
modifiers.Clip.params.overlay_attributes.title: Overlay attributes to copy
modifiers.Clip.params.prefix.description: Added in front of the names of the attributes copied from the overlay (each mode).
modifiers.Clip.params.prefix.title: Prefix of the copied attributes
modifiers.ClipRasterByMask.description: Clips each raster by polygons (communes, parcels) or by an extent; pixels outside the polygon are masked.
modifiers.ClipRasterByMask.help: By polygons: the second input ("mask") gives the polygons, in any system (they are reprojected). "union": a single raster per original raster, clipped by the union of the polygons; "each": one raster per polygon, with its attributes ("Mask attributes to copy"): for example one DEM per commune. "Crop" reduces the raster to the extent of the polygons; otherwise it keeps its size and only the pixels outside the polygon are masked. "All touched" includes any pixel the polygon touches, even slightly. By extent: West, South, East, North in the raster's system. A polygon that does not cover the raster gives nothing.
modifiers.ClipRasterByMask.label: Clip raster by mask
modifiers.ClipRasterByMask.params.all_touched.desc: Keeps any pixel the polygon touches.
modifiers.ClipRasterByMask.params.by.description: features: polygons ("mask" input); extent: a typed extent.
modifiers.ClipRasterByMask.params.by.title: Clip by
modifiers.ClipRasterByMask.params.crop.description: Reduces the raster to the extent of the clip.
modifiers.ClipRasterByMask.params.crop.title: Crop
modifiers.ClipRasterByMask.params.extent.descripti: West, South, East, North in the raster's system (by extent).
modifiers.ClipRasterByMask.params.extent.title: Extent
"each" mode: added to the produced rasters.
modifiers.ClipRasterByMask.params.mode.description: union: one result per raster; each: one result per polygon.
modifiers.ClipRasterByMask.params.mode.title: Polygons
modifiers.ComponentInput.description: Defines an input of the component: the features received on this port arrive here.
modifiers.ComponentInput.help: Place it in a flow that serves as a component. In the flow that uses the component, this port becomes an input of the node. To test the component alone, give a sample file: it is read only if the flow is run directly (never when it serves as a component).
modifiers.ComponentInput.label: Component input
modifiers.ComponentInput.params.port.title: Port name
modifiers.ComponentInput.params.sample.title: Sample file
modifiers.ComponentOutput.description: Defines an output of the component: the features received here leave through this port.
modifiers.ComponentOutput.help: Place it in a flow that serves as a component. In the flow that uses the component, this port becomes an output of the node. Run alone, the node simply lets the features through (useful to inspect them).
modifiers.ComponentOutput.label: Component output
modifiers.ComponentOutput.params.port.title: Port name
modifiers.Contour.description: Draws the contour lines of a digital elevation model: one line per contour, with its elevation.
modifiers.Contour.help: A contour is drawn every "Interval" (10 m: 100, 110, 120…), starting from "Base elevation", or for the elevations of "Levels" if the list is filled in. Each line carries its elevation ("Elevation attribute") and the raster's attributes. "Minimum length" drops small contours (islets). No-data pixels interrupt the contours. The raster is read into memory (at most 40 million pixels: clip first beyond that). Lines are in the raster's coordinate system.
modifiers.Contour.label: Contour lines
modifiers.Contour.params.band.title: Band
modifiers.Contour.params.base.description: Elevation to which the series of contours is anchored.
modifiers.Contour.params.base.title: Base elevation
modifiers.Contour.params.elevation_attribute.descr: Receives the elevation of the contour.
modifiers.Contour.params.elevation_attribute.title: Elevation attribute
modifiers.Contour.params.interval.title: Interval
modifiers.Contour.params.levels.title: Levels
modifiers.Contour.params.min_length.description: Drops shorter contours (unit of the system).
modifiers.Contour.params.min_length.title: Minimum length
modifiers.ConvertDate.description: Reads a date written as text (or a timestamp) and converts it: date, date-time, formatted text, Unix seconds.
modifiers.ConvertDate.help: "Read format" is a strptime format (%d/%m/%Y, %Y%m%d, %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S…); empty = automatic reading of ISO formats (2026-10-11, 2026-10-11T08:30:00). An attribute that is already a date or date-time needs no format. Result: date, date-time, text (with "Write format", e.g. %d/%m/%Y) or epoch (seconds since 1970, UTC). An unreadable value sends the feature to "Rejected", or becomes empty if "Unreadable value" is null. Codes: %Y year, %m month, %d day, %H hour, %M minute, %S second, %B month name, %A day name.
modifiers.ConvertDate.label: Convert a date
modifiers.ConvertDate.params.attribute.title: Attribute
modifiers.ConvertDate.params.destination.title: Result attribute
modifiers.ConvertDate.params.from_format.descripti: strptime format of the text, e.g. %d/%m/%Y; empty = automatic ISO.
modifiers.ConvertDate.params.from_format.title: Read format
modifiers.ConvertDate.params.on_error.description: reject: the feature goes to "Rejected"; null: the value becomes empty.
modifiers.ConvertDate.params.on_error.title: Unreadable value
modifiers.ConvertDate.params.to.description: date, datetime, text or epoch (Unix seconds, UTC).
modifiers.ConvertDate.params.to.title: Result
modifiers.ConvertDate.params.to_format.title: Write format
modifiers.Counter.description: Adds a sequence number to each feature, in arrival order (per group if requested).
modifiers.Counter.help: Without a group: 1, 2, 3… With "Group by": numbering restarts at "Start" for each value.
modifiers.Counter.label: Counter
modifiers.Counter.params.attribute.description: Name of the attribute that receives the number.
modifiers.Counter.params.attribute.title: Created attribute
modifiers.Counter.params.group_by.description: Empty: a single numbering; otherwise it restarts at "Start" for each value.
modifiers.Counter.params.group_by.title: Group by
modifiers.Counter.params.start.title: Start
modifiers.Counter.params.step.title: Step

modifiers.CreateFeatures.description: Creates one or more features from scratch: computed attributes and optional geometry.
modifiers.CreateFeatures.help: Starting point of a flow that has no file to read: a single feature to trigger downstream nodes (DatabaseQuery, HttpRequest, RunFlow…) or several test features. Each attribute is a SQL expression that can use `_index` (0, 1, 2…); the following expressions see the previous ones. Geometry: "none", "point" (X and Y) or "wkt" (WKT text, e.g. POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 0))). The coordinate system applies to the geometry.
modifiers.CreateFeatures.label: Create features
modifiers.CreateFeatures.params.attributes.descrip: Computed in order, for each feature.
modifiers.CreateFeatures.params.attributes.title: Attributes
modifiers.CreateFeatures.params.count.title: Number of features
modifiers.CreateFeatures.params.crs.title: Coordinate system
modifiers.CreateFeatures.params.geometry.title: Geometry
modifiers.CreateFeatures.params.wkt.description: WKT geometry, the same for all features.
modifiers.CreateFeatures.params.wkt.title: WKT
modifiers.CreateFeatures.params.x.description: SQL expression of X, e.g. 1.5 or 600000 + "_index".
modifiers.CreateFeatures.params.x.title: X (point)
modifiers.CreateFeatures.params.y.title: Y (point)
modifiers.CreateGrid.description: Generates a grid of squares or hexagons over an extent (typed, or that of the received features).
modifiers.CreateGrid.help: The extent is typed (X min, Y min, X max, Y max, in the chosen coordinate system) or, with "Extent of the received features", taken from the geometries of the input (the node then has an input, and the grid takes their coordinate system). "Size" is the width of a cell, in the unit of the system (meters in Lambert-93): for a hexagon, the distance between two opposite sides. Each cell receives its number (`cell_id`), its column and its row. Hexagons slightly overflow the extent; "Keep only cells that touch the features" drops the others. At most 5 million cells.
modifiers.CreateGrid.label: Grid
modifiers.CreateGrid.params.crs.title: Coordinate system
modifiers.CreateGrid.params.from_input.description: Takes the extent from the geometries of the input.
modifiers.CreateGrid.params.from_input.title: Extent of the received features
modifiers.CreateGrid.params.only_touching.descript: With the extent of the features: drops the cells that meet none of them.
modifiers.CreateGrid.params.only_touching.title: Keep only cells that touch the features
modifiers.CreateGrid.params.shape.title: Shape
modifiers.CreateGrid.params.size.description: Width of a cell, in the unit of the coordinate system.
modifiers.CreateGrid.params.size.title: Size
modifiers.CreateGrid.params.xmax.title: X max
modifiers.CreateGrid.params.xmin.title: X min
modifiers.CreateGrid.params.ymax.title: Y max
modifiers.CreateGrid.params.ymin.title: Y min
modifiers.CsvReader.description: Reads a CSV (or delimited text) file; a WKT column or X/Y columns give the geometry.
modifiers.CsvReader.help: Columns are read as text (codes with a leading zero are kept), unless "Detect types" is ticked. Give the WKT column, or the X and Y columns, to get a geometry, with its coordinate system. A pattern (folder/*.csv) reads every file: their columns are joined by name.
modifiers.CsvReader.label: CSV reader
modifiers.CsvReader.params.add_filename.descriptio: Adds the "filename" column (useful with a file pattern).

modifiers.CsvReader.params.delimiter.title: Delimiter
modifiers.CsvReader.params.detect_types.descriptio: Otherwise everything is read as text: codes with a leading zero are kept.
modifiers.CsvReader.params.detect_types.title: Detect types

modifiers.DatabaseQuery.description: Runs an SQL statement on a database (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and sends the rows it returns.
modifiers.DatabaseQuery.help: The SQL is that of the database of the connection. By default it runs **read-only** (SELECT). Tick "Allow writing" for an UPDATE, a CREATE TABLE… (committed at the end, rolled back on error); a RETURNING (PostgreSQL) returns rows. To return a geometry, produce it as WKB under the name "geometry": ST_AsBinary(geom) AS geometry (PostGIS), SDO_UTIL.TO_WKBGEOMETRY(geom) AS "geometry" (Oracle); its coordinate system is set in "Coordinate system".
modifiers.DatabaseQuery.label: SQL (creator)
modifiers.DatabaseQuery.params.allow_write.descrip: Unchecked: read-only (SELECT). Checked: UPDATE, CREATE TABLE… allowed, committed at the end.
modifiers.DatabaseQuery.params.allow_write.title: Allow writing
modifiers.DatabaseQuery.params.connection.title: Connection
modifiers.DatabaseQuery.params.crs.title: Coordinate system
modifiers.DatabaseQuery.params.sql.title: SQL
modifiers.DatabaseQueryPerFeature.description: Runs a SQL statement for each feature, injecting its attributes; adds the result.
modifiers.DatabaseQueryPerFeature.help: Write `{{attribute}}` in the SQL: the feature's value is passed as a **bound parameter** (never pasted into the text: no SQL injection). E.g. SELECT name FROM communes WHERE code = {{insee}}. "first" adds the columns of the first row of the result; "all" produces one feature per row. A feature with no result goes to "NoResult". Read-only unless "Allow writing" (everything is committed at the end, rolled back on error). One query per feature: plan for a SQL join if the volume is large.
modifiers.DatabaseQueryPerFeature.label: SQL (per feature)
modifiers.DatabaseQueryPerFeature.params.allow_wri: Unchecked: read-only (SELECT). Checked: UPDATE, INSERT… allowed, committed at the end.
modifiers.DatabaseQueryPerFeature.params.prefix.de: Added in front of the names of the added columns.
modifiers.DatabaseQueryPerFeature.params.rows.desc: first: the columns of the first result row are added to the feature; all: one feature per result row.
modifiers.DatabaseQueryPerFeature.params.sql.title: SQL
modifiers.Dissolve.description: Merges the polygons (or lines) of each group into a single geometry, without internal boundaries.
modifiers.Dissolve.help: One feature per group, with the attributes of the first feature of the group. Touching polygons are merged; lines are gathered then joined end to end when possible. Features without geometry are ignored. Different from Aggregate, which gathers without merging.
modifiers.Dissolve.label: Dissolve
modifiers.Dissolve.params.count_attribute.title: Feature count attribute
modifiers.Dissolve.params.group_by.title: Group by
modifiers.DropAttributes.description: Deletes the chosen attributes; all the others are kept.
modifiers.DropAttributes.help: A missing attribute is a configuration error (unless "Ignore missing attributes" is checked).
modifiers.DropAttributes.label: Remove attributes
modifiers.DropAttributes.params.attributes.descrip: Attributes to delete; empty = nothing is removed.
modifiers.DropAttributes.params.attributes.title: Attributes to remove
modifiers.DropAttributes.params.ignore_missing.des: Unchecked: an attribute missing from the data is an error; checked: it is ignored.
modifiers.DropAttributes.params.remove_geometry.de: Also removes the geometry of the features.

modifiers.ExcelWriter.label: Excel writer

modifiers.ExcelWriter.params.sheet.title: Sheet
modifiers.ExecuteSql.description: Runs a DuckDB SQL query on one or more inputs of the flow (joins, aggregates, windows, spatial).
modifiers.ExecuteSql.help: Each input is a table named after the port: `SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM input p GROUP BY p.name`. Several inputs (the "Inputs" list) allow joins: `SELECT a.*, b.value FROM a JOIN b ON a.code = b.code`. The geometry is the `geometry` column (DuckDB ST_… functions: ST_Area, ST_Intersects, ST_Buffer…) and comes back in the result with the coordinate system of the first input. A single SELECT statement; no file reading and no network access. The result leaves on "output".
modifiers.ExecuteSql.label: SQL query on the inputs
modifiers.ExecuteSql.params.inputs.description: Names of the input ports (letters, digits and _); each one is a table of the query.
modifiers.ExecuteSql.params.inputs.title: Inputs
modifiers.ExecuteSql.params.sql.description: A DuckDB SELECT (or WITH … SELECT) statement.
modifiers.ExecuteSql.params.sql.title: SQL query
modifiers.ExplodeList.description: Produces one feature per element of a list-typed attribute (the other attributes are copied).
modifiers.ExplodeList.help: The attribute must be a list (e.g. from a PostgreSQL array or from "Split text" in list mode). An empty or null list produces no feature, unless "Keep empty lists" is checked (one feature with an empty element). "Index attribute" numbers the elements from 0.
modifiers.ExplodeList.label: Explode a list
modifiers.ExplodeList.params.attribute.description: List-typed attribute to explode (one feature per element).
modifiers.ExplodeList.params.attribute.title: List attribute
modifiers.ExplodeList.params.element.title: Element attribute
modifiers.ExplodeList.params.index.title: Index attribute
modifiers.ExplodeList.params.keep_empty.descriptio: An empty or null list still gives one feature (empty element) instead of disappearing.
modifiers.ExplodeList.params.keep_empty.title: Keep empty lists
modifiers.ExtractByExpression.description: Sends the features to "Passed" if they satisfy the conditions, otherwise to "Failed".
modifiers.ExtractByExpression.help: Each condition is a boolean SQL expression: "pop" >= 1000 ; "name" LIKE 'Saint%' ; "code" IN ('31', '09') ; ST_Area(geometry) > 500. A null condition counts as false. A feature whose evaluation fails goes to "Rejected" with the reason.
modifiers.ExtractByExpression.label: Extract by expression
modifiers.ExtractByExpression.params.combine.descr: AND: all the conditions; OR: at least one.
modifiers.ExtractByExpression.params.combine.title: Combine with
modifiers.ExtractByLocation.description: Splits the "candidate" features according to their spatial relation with the "filter" features.
modifiers.ExtractByLocation.help: A candidate feature leaves on "Passed" if it satisfies the relation (intersects, within, contains, touches, within N units…) with **at least one** "filter" feature, otherwise on "Failed". Features without geometry go to "Rejected". Both inputs must have the same coordinate system. "Invert" swaps Passed and Failed.
modifiers.ExtractByLocation.label: Spatial filter
modifiers.ExtractByLocation.params.distance.title: Distance (dwithin)
modifiers.ExtractByLocation.params.invert.descript: Swaps the Passed and Failed outputs.
modifiers.ExtractByLocation.params.invert.title: Invert Passed and Failed
modifiers.ExtractByLocation.params.predicate.descr: candidate <relation> filter ("within": candidate is within filter).
modifiers.ExtractByLocation.params.predicate.title: Relation
modifiers.ExtractCoordinates.description: Writes X, Y (and Z) of a characteristic point of the geometry into attributes.
modifiers.ExtractCoordinates.help: Point used: the point itself, the centroid, a point guaranteed to be inside the area, the first or last vertex, or the center of the bounding box. Coordinates are those of the geometry's coordinate system. "Bounds" adds `prefix_minx`, `_miny`, `_maxx`, `_maxy`.
modifiers.ExtractCoordinates.label: Extract coordinates

modifiers.STACSearch.description: Searches images in a STAC catalog (Sentinel-2, Landsat, DEMs…) and references them without downloading.
modifiers.STACSearch.help: Queries the STAC API "Catalog address" (Element 84's Earth Search by default; Planetary Computer: https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/api/stac/v1 with signing enabled). Filters: collections, extent (WGS84 longitude/latitude), dates (2024-06-01/2024-06-30), properties (JSON, e.g. {"eo:cloud_cover": {"lt": 20}}). With "Received geometries", each feature of the input gives a search (its extent) and its attributes are copied. "Assets" lists the wanted bands (e.g. red, nir: their names in the catalog): each scene becomes a virtual raster whose bands are these assets, read on demand over HTTP (nothing is downloaded entirely). Each feature carries the scene identifier, its date, its collection and the requested properties. The computer's proxy is used.

modifiers.TerrainAnalysis.description: Computes the slope, aspect, hillshade or roughness of a digital elevation model.
modifiers.TerrainAnalysis.help: The input raster is a DEM (elevations). Products: slope (in degrees or percent), aspect (direction the slope faces, in degrees clockwise from north; -1 on flat ground), hillshade (shading from 0 to 255, according to "Azimuth" and "Sun elevation"), roughness (difference between a pixel and its neighbors). Each product becomes a band. Derivatives use Horn's method (8 neighbors). "Z factor" converts elevations to the horizontal unit (1 if both are in meters). In degrees (WGS84), pixel size is converted to meters at the pixel's latitude. Edge pixels and those with a no-data neighbor stay no-data.

modifiers.WarpRaster.description: Changes the coordinate system of a raster, with choice of resolution and resampling.
modifiers.WarpRaster.help: The raster is recomputed in the "Target system" (EPSG:2154, EPSG:4326…). "Resolution" is the size of a pixel in the unit of the target system; empty or 0 = chosen to keep roughly the same number of pixels. Resampling: nearest for classes (land cover), bilinear or cubic for continuous values (elevation, reflectance), average to reduce the resolution. The computation is done in 512-pixel windows, in parallel: memory stays bounded whatever the raster size. Pixels outside the original image become "no data".

modifiers.Writer.description: Writes the received features to a file.
modifiers.Writer.help: Modes: "create" fails if the file exists, "overwrite" replaces it, "append" adds. For a GeoPackage (layers) or an Excel workbook (sheets), several Writers can write different elements into the same file: in "overwrite" mode only the targeted layer or sheet is replaced. Shapefile: column names limited to 10 characters (renamings are logged), .cpg file in UTF-8, 2 GB limit. (Geo)Parquet: "partition by" writes one folder per value. On the team share, the file is written locally then published in one go: an error or an interruption midway leaves the existing file intact, and the publication error is reported (file open by a colleague, share not mounted).

modifiers.ZonalStatistics.description: Computes statistics of a raster under each polygon: mean, sum, minimum, maximum, majority…
modifiers.ZonalStatistics.help: Each polygon of "zones" receives the statistics of the pixels of the raster it covers (a pixel counts if its center is inside the polygon, or if it is touched with "All touched"). Columns are named `band_statistic` (for example ndvi_mean). Statistics: count, sum, mean, min, max, std, median, majority (most frequent value: land cover classes), unique (number of distinct values), area (area of valid pixels, in the unit of the system squared). No-data pixels are ignored. If there are several rasters (dates, scenes), the result has one row per zone and per raster, with the "Raster attributes to add" (for example the date). A polygon outside the raster has a count of 0 and empty statistics. Polygons are reprojected into the raster's system.
